title: Prime localization preserves reducedness
statement: Let $R$ be a reduced commutative ring (every nilpotent element is zero) and $\mathfrak p\subset R$ a prime ideal. Then the localization $R_{\mathfrak p}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] is reduced: every nilpotent element of $R_{\mathfrak p}$ is zero.

source.place: Algebra, proof of Lemma Tag 031R (lemma-criterion-reduced, lines 43949-43956), where each $R_{\mathfrak p}$ of a reduced $R$ is taken to be reduced; the localization fact is stated as a hint in Algebra, proof of Lemma Tag 04KN (lemma-geometrically-reduced-permanence, line 10094)
